output_list.reason: The transfer, transferETH and transferNNS functions have an integer overflow.

The withdrawOwnerEvent, withdrawOwner, withdrawOwnerFee and withdrawOwnerTime functions are using the RANDOM_EXT_INFO.devdata as a seed for the random function, which is bad since the devdata value is set byTempData.create(data, name, iv) where name is an alias for the contract name, and iv is the number of the vector in the iv list. This means the function has a hardcoded list of names and iv values, and randomly picks one of them to execute, potentially allowing unauthorized access.
The buyHeart, round and luckybuy functions have access control issues, allowing unauthorized users to change the owner of the contract and change the balance of the owner.
